findings.summary: Verifier derives changedPaths from baseRevision..HEAD and reads module sources from the current checkout (lines 1862-1890), while role preparation derives them from candidate.headRevision. Thus verification is not pinned to the frozen Candidate: any later checkout change can alter expected attack surfaces and module closure, and the verifier may accept/reject evidence for a different revision. These Git-derived inputs must use candidate.headRevision throughout.

residualRisks: Role evidence cannot be trusted across post-prepare checkout movement until verifier-side diff and module-source inputs are read from candidate.headRevision.
